name: Black Infant Health Program
description: The Black Infant Health Program is California's free, community-based program providing group and one-on-one support to Black women and birthing people during pregnancy and after birth.
fullDescription: The Black Infant Health Program is California's free, community-based program providing group and one-on-one support to Black women and birthing people during pregnancy and after birth.
whatTheyOffer:
- 10 prenatal and 10 postpartum group sessions (ages 18+)
- One-on-one support and goal setting (including ages 16-17)
- Life skills and stress management
- Health education on pregnancy, labor, and newborn care
- Social support and community building
- Referrals to medical, dental, and social services
- Available through local health departments in participating counties
howToGetIt: Contact your local Black Infant Health program through the state website. Services are free and open to Black women and birthing people age 16+ who are pregnant or up to six months postpartum when they enroll, regardless of income.
keywords: Black Infant Health, BIH, African American, pregnancy, maternal health, prenatal, postpartum, birth outcomes, support group, Black mothers
